title: Nourishing Crispy Croatian Shirataki Skewers
description: Savory and crispy Croatian dish featuring shirataki, marinated in a blend of herbs and spices, perfect for a nourishing dinner. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly dish is made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, thyme, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shirataki noodles to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shirataki noodles onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skewers hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
